name: "CodeQL"

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'r5.*'
      - 'r6.*'
      - 'releases/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'releases/**'
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 2 * * 4'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'
    permissions:
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - language: actions
            build-mode: none
          - language: java-kotlin
            build-mode: manual
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: 'Set up JDK 25'
        uses: actions/setup-java@d1374f8ac74474200d16ef8ecee22c7ae7a51880 # v6.3.0
        with:
          java-version: 25
          distribution: liberica
      - uses: sbt/setup-sbt@67d461eba2c4753196c230e02da850757ba4775e # v1.5.14
      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@33d7b85da1a04171e211befe2c739303b9a4c066 # v4.39.3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
          build-mode: ${{ matrix.build-mode }}
      - if: matrix.build-mode == 'manual'
        run: java src/Builder.java --target=compile
        env:
          CODEQL_EXTRACTOR_JAVA_AGENT_DISABLE_KOTLIN: true # blocked by https://github.com/github/codeql/issues/21938
      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@33d7b85da1a04171e211befe2c739303b9a4c066 # v4.39.3
        with:
          category: "/language:${{matrix.language}}"
